issue: XML sitemap includes all 73 noindex blog tag pages (/blog/tag/*)
evidence: sitemap-0.xml contains 155 <loc> entries; 73 of them are /blog/tag/* pages that simultaneously carry a <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> tag
impact: Not a critical error — Google tolerates noindex pages in a sitemap and will simply not index them — but it's a minor crawl-budget inefficiency and a slightly inconsistent signal ("please index this list" vs "please don't index this specific page")
recommended_fix: Optional: extend the sitemap filter() in astro.config.mjs to also exclude /blog/tag/ paths, consistent with how /contact/thanks and /book/thanks are already excluded
validation_method: Re-run the sitemap <loc> vs noindex-page crawl after the change; confirm tag pages remain crawlable (noindex,follow preserved) just not sitemap-submitted
